senses.gloss: caumukha (HA), Sanskrit caturmukha (cf. caturmukha-bimba); a quadruple image called pratimā sarvatobhadrikā (LL) in the Mathurā inscriptions of the Kuṣāṇa period, showing one Jina or several Jinas on each of the four faces; also seen on the top or in the centre of representations of the samavasaraṇa (q. v.).
